desc: The Smith & Wesson M&P airgun from UMAREX is a .177 caliber Co2 powered pistol, and is not permitted for use in airsoft competitions or skirmishes. This premium grade airgun combines high-performance with high value, and is perfect for those looking for a powerful practice pistol on a budget; without having to make compromises in quality or performance. Designed after the real Smith & Wesson Military & Police Pistol, this replica is crafted from a high quality polymer for a lightweight yet reliable construction. A single 12g Co2 cartridge powers this training pistol and is housed within the grip. The specially designed ergonomic grip offers a comfortable platform while providing optimal grip and stability in all weather conditions. A small weaver rail is integrated underneath the barrel of the pistol for the option to attach your choice of tactical flashlight or laser. Shooting at 480 FPS, you will have no problem hitting those hard to reach targets. Fixed front and rear sights allow users to quickly and accurately zero in their targets without the need of an additional optic accessory. The semi-auto design allows you to fire as fast as you can pull the trigger, with no delay or having to manually cock back the slide between each shot. Hone in your shooting skills with the Smith & Wesson M&P airgun from UMAREX.
